name: slidecraft
description: Prompt-and-file driven slide presentation builder: HTML decks and PPTX export, themeable layouts, OpenAI-written content.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm test -w shared && npm test -w server
